scientific_integrity: All conclusions are for finite words on labeled alphabets with an involution having both at least one 2-cycle and at least one fixed point; full proof supplied. Finite code checks do not prove the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Only exact minimum-length k-subsequence-universality under a single involutory antimorphism; longer words, other symmetries and approximate universality are not classified. Ordinary and fixed-point-free boundary cases are excluded from the new claim. Independent scientific audit not performed.
title: Optimal subsequence-universal pseudopalindromes for mixed alphabet involutions
